account.exclusionHint: Take a break from betting. Once started it cannot be cancelled before it ends.

payments.secondApproval: Approved once; waiting for a second check.
payments.heldLine: {held} on hold for a withdrawal · {available} available
payments.note: Deposits and withdrawals are checked and confirmed by our team, usually within one working day.
payments.depositBlocked: Deposits are paused while you are self-excluded. You can still withdraw your balance.

methods.label: Payment method
methods.BANK_TRANSFER_help: To or from a bank account in your name
methods.CASH_AT_SHOP_help: At a partner shop, with your ID and reference code

bank.instructions: Make the transfer from {bank} or any bank and put your reference code in the payment details. Your balance is credited once we see the money.

shop.depositInstructions: Pay the amount in cash at any partner shop, showing your ID and the reference code. Your balance is credited once the shop confirms.
shop.withdrawInstructions: Once approved you can collect the cash at a partner shop with your ID and this reference code.

deposit.label: Deposit
deposit.title: Request a deposit
deposit.help: Choose how you will pay and how much. You will get a reference code and payment details.
deposit.doneHelp: Use these details to pay. We credit your balance when the money arrives.
deposit.payerReferenceHelp: If you already paid, the reference from your bank helps us match it.

withdraw.label: Withdrawal
withdraw.title: Request a withdrawal
withdraw.help: We pay out after a check. The amount is put on hold now so it is not bet by mistake.
withdraw.done: Withdrawal request for {amount} created. The amount is on hold.
withdraw.bankNext: We will transfer the money to your account after the check, usually within one working day.
withdraw.alreadyPending: You already have a withdrawal waiting. You can cancel it below in My requests.
withdraw.holder: Account holder (as on the bank account)
withdraw.holdNote: The amount is held until the withdrawal is completed or cancelled; you can cancel while it is waiting.
